title: 2026 Technology Graduate Programme – Platform Engineer
description:
Man Group is a global alternative investment management firm managing $228.7 billion and headquartered in London. This is a Technology Graduate Programme focused on Platform Engineering.

About the Programme:
The Technology Graduate Programme begins with a 3-month bootcamp in software development followed by the opportunity to explore three Platform Engineering teams over two years. This includes Python Platform, Infrastructure (Linux, Windows, Networks, Storage, Databases, Infosec), End-User, and Architecture and Operations.

What You'll Learn:
- Managing large internal data centres with tens of thousands of cores and hundreds of terabytes of memory, running Python at scale
- Building and managing Man Group's infrastructure, both on-premises and in the cloud, using technologies such as Python, .Net, Linux, Windows Server, Databases and Storage Systems
- Writing software to automate infrastructure and creating flexible self-service technology for thousands of users
- Maintaining reliable systems while administering petabyte-scale storage and large GPU deployments
- Operating and optimising global network interconnects within data centres
- Working closely with business stakeholders in a dynamic environment

Key Skills & Experience Required:
- Experience with programming/scripting languages: C#, Java, Python, Powershell, or C++
- Technical experience from open source maintenance, 2+ years of industry experience, or recent Computer Science/Engineering/Mathematics/Physics degree graduate
- Understanding of source control and continuous deployment workflows (git)
- Experience administrating operating systems (Linux, Windows, MacOS) and understanding of cloud technologies
- Self-organised with ability to prioritise and manage multiple projects
- Excellent communication and problem-solving skills
- Exceptional troubleshooting skills
- Self-starter with desire to learn

Programme Start Date: Throughout 2026

Application Process:
1. CV Screen
2. Online Technical Test
3. Pair Programming Interview
4. Technical Interview
5. Final Interview

Explicitly mention any experience with Windows Server administration or database administration, if applicable, to address potential gaps.
